description: 50 patient profiles for ExhalePath vision evaluation: disease + location + demographics → ranked VOC Δppb with pathway/cell/site explainability, scored against measured or high-accuracy approximate ground truth.

scoring_notes.vision_fidelity_pct: Mean composite score across all 50 profiles (includes Grade D prior-aligned cases).
scoring_notes.evidence_backed_pct: Mean composite over Grade A+B only (measured/directional literature).
scoring_notes.held_out_style_pct: Mean composite over Grade A+B+C (excludes prior-only Grade D).
scoring_notes.grade_D_circularity: Grade D ground truth is derived from atlas mechanistic priors; high scores there measure prior consistency, not independent clinical accuracy.
